Hums old battle hymns under their breath
Squints at everyone as if nearsighted
Chews on a piece of straw
Stares just over your shoulder while talking
Laughs at their own jokes — twice
Tugs at their collar when stressed
Repeats the last word you said — said
Draws little symbols in spilled ale
Bows slightly to every passing dog
Counts on fingers during any negotiation
